Importance of Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora
The virtues and merits of Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora can be best understood based on the traditions of the Holy Infalliables (a.s.) which have been narrated regarding its importance and recitation. There are many incidents by which the importance of this Ziyaarat is realized . 
The Ziyaarat is followed by 2 rakaats namaaz and a dua known as [Dua-e-Alqamah](E8) which Imam Sadiq (a.s.) used to recite after Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora and he also taught the same to his companion Alqamah (r.a.).
Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora: In the light of traditions
The importance and merits of reciting Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora can be understood from the following traditions:
Tradition 1
Alqamah bin Mohammed ibn Hazrami (r.a.) narrates ‘I requested Imam Baqir (a.s.) to teach me a dua that I should recite on the day of Ashoora after the reciting the Ziyaarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) - from near his (a.s.) grave or from a distance.’ Imam (a.s.) replied
‘O Alqamah, whenever you wish to recite the Ziyaarat of Imam Husain (a.s.), you first perform two units of prayers. Then turn towards the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.) and while pointing towards it, you first say ‘Salam’ and then ‘Takbeer’. Thereafter, you recite this Ziyaarat (Ziyaarat-e-Aashura). If you do so, then as if you have recited the supplication read by the angels while visiting the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.). Moreover, when you recite this Ziyaarat, then
(a)	Allah will record a million good deeds for you, erase a million sins and add a hundred million ranks to your rank.
(b)	You will be included among those people who were martyred along with Imam Husain (a.s.) and you will share their ranks.
(c)	On the day of Judgment, you will be included among the martyrs
(d)	You will get the reward of all the Prophets, Messengers and all the people who have visited the grave of Imam Husain (a.s.) from the day that he (a.s.) was martyred till date.
And the way of reciting the Ziyaarat is like this…’
(Then Imam (a.s.) recited the entire Ziyaarat-e-Ashura for Alqamah (r.a.))
(Kaamil al-Ziyarat, Ibn Qoolwayh, Ch. 71, p.194)
At the end of this tradition, Imam Baqir (a.s.) says:
‘O Alqamah, if you can, then recite this Ziyaarat every day send salutations to Imam Husain (a.s.). You will get all the rewards (of the one who recites it on the day of Ashoora).’
Tradition 2
Imam Sadiq (a.s.) informs,
‘The one who does the Ziyaarat of Imam Husain (a.s.) on the day of Ashoora, then paradise is obligatory upon him.’
(Behaar al-Anwaar, vol. 101, p.104)
Ziyarat-e-Ashoora: Hadees-e-Qudsi
The greatest merit for this Ziyaarat is that it is the ‘Word of Allah’ (Hadees-e-Qudsi). Safwan (r.a.) narrates that Hazrat Jibraeel (a.s.) conveyed this Ziyaarat to Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) on divine command and it has reached Imam Baqir (a.s.) through his noble ancestors.
Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora: Emphasis of Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.)
The emperor of the era, the chief of the universe, Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) has stressed the importance of reciting Ziyarat-e-Ashoora.
Shaykh Mohaddis Noori (r.a.) in his book “Najmus Saqib” writes that there was a person called Syed Ahmed Rashty who was on his way to Hajj with his companions.
It was winter and one night there was snow and ice accompanied by strong winds. 
Syed Ahmed got separated from his companions. 
He says he was trembling with fear and cold as it was a place where people often looted.  Suddenly he saw a person with a shovel freeing the tree branches which were burdened with snow. The man greeted Syed Ahmed saying “Assalamu Alaykum Syed Ahmed! Where are you going?” Amazed at the person knowing his name he said he was on his way to Hajj but had lost his way.  The man told him “Alayka bin Nafela! Nafela! Nafela!” Syed Ahmed prayed his Maghrib and Isha salaah finishing each with its Nafela.  He saw the man again who asked him, “Have you not gone yet?” Syed Ahmed replied “No!” The man said, “Alayka bil Jaameah! Jaameah! Jaameah!”
Syed Ahmed says that I did not know [Ziyarat-e-Jameah](G13) by heart but that day I could recite it as though I had memorised it. The man told him, “Alayka bil Ashoora! Ashoora! Ashoora!”
Syed Ahmed recited Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora and [Dua Alqamah](E8). The man then mounted on his horse and took him to his caravan and the companions he had been separated from.
As he parted Imam (a.t.f.s.) said to Syed Ahmed, “REMEMBER ZIYAARAT-E-ASHOORA, THERE IS NO GREATER GIFT THAN IT.” 
We see how Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) helped Syed Ahmed and stressed upon the recitation of Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora. It also points to the fact that Imam-e-Zamana (a.t.f.s.) desires that his followers should always remember the tribulations of his grandfather Imam Husain (a.s.) and they should always be aggrieved and anguished by the events of Karbala.
Safwan's Discourse on the Merit of Ziyaarat of Ashoora
Sayf ibn Umayrah has reported that he said to Safwan, “Alqamah ibn Muhammad has not reported this supplication to us from Imam al-Baqir (a.s.). He has only reported the ziyarah form.”
Answering him, Safwan said:
I once accompanied my master al-Sadiq, Allah’s peace and blessings be upon him, to this very place. He did as same as we have just done as regarding the method of ziyarah and then, after offering a prayer similar to the one we have just offered and bidding the visited Imam farewell as same as we have done, he said this very supplication.
Safwan added, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) said to me, “Observe this form of ziyarah and this supplication and use them whenever you visit (the Imam). Surely, I guarantee on behalf of Almighty Allah for any one who says this form of ziyarah and this supplication while visiting the holy tomb or being at a distant place that his visit will be accepted, his efforts will be praiseworthy, his greetings will reach the Imams and will never be screened from them, all his requests will be granted by Almighty Allah whatever they will be, and he will never be disappointed. O Safwan, the Imam (a.s.) added, I have received this very guarantee for those who use this form of ziyarah when visiting the holy tombs from my father who received it from his father Ali ibn al-Husayn (a.s.) who received it from his father al-Husayn (a.s.) who received it from his brother al-Hasan (a.s.) who received it from his father the Commander of the Faithful who received it from the Messenger of Allah who received it from Archangel Jibraeel who received it from Almighty Allah, Who undertook for any one who would visit Imam al-Husayn (‘a) with this form of ziyarah and say this very supplication from the holy shrine or from a distant place that He (i.e. Almighty Allah) Himself should accept his visitation, grant him his requests whatever they would be, and respond to his prayers. Moreover, the visitor should never leave with disappointment; rather, Almighty Allah should make him leave with pleasure and delight of his eye due to settling of his needs, winning Paradise, being manumitted from Hellfire, and being granted the right to intercede for whomever he wishes except those who openly incur the animosity of the Ahl al-Bayt (a.s.). Almighty Allah, as was maintained by Archangel Gabriel, undertook this pledge and called the angels to witness for it after the angels of His Kingdom had witnessed the same. O Allah’s Messenger, Archangel Gabriel added, Almighty Allah has sent me to carry this pleasant and good tidings to you as well as to Ali, Fatimah, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, the Imams from your descendants, and your adherents (i.e. Shi'ah) up to the Resurrection Day. Up to the Resurrection Day, you as well as ‘Ali, Fatimah, al-Hasan, al-Husayn, and your adherents shall be pleased.
Safwan added, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) then said to me: O Safwan, whenever you have an impenetrable problem that cannot be solved except by Almighty Allah, you must then visit (Imam al-Husayn) with this form of ziyarah, wherever you would be, and follow it with this supplication. You may then beseech your Lord to grant you your request and the response shall soon come from Almighty Allah Who never fails in His promise to His Messenger; out of His magnanimity and favoring. All praise be then to Allah.
More Confirmations
In the book of al-Najm al-Saaqib (by al-Nuri), the story of the attendance of Hajj Sayyid Ahmad al-Rashti in the presence of the Imam of the Age, may our souls be accepted as ransoms from him, during his journey of the hajj pilgrimage, has been told in details. In one of the details of this story, which will be cited in this book after the Major Comprehensive Form of ziyaarah (al-Ziyaarah al-Jaamea;h al-Kabeerah), the Imam (a.s.) said to al-Rashti with confirmation, “Why do you not (frequently) recite the ziyarah of ‘Ashoora’, ‘Ashoora’, ‘Ashoora’, ‘Ashoora’...?”
Commenting on this, our trustworthy mentor Shaykh al-Nuri said:
One of the unparalleled merits and points of honor of ziyarah of ‘Ashura’ is that its form is not similar to the other ordinary forms of ziyarah, which have been composed and dictated by the Holy Infallibles apparently, although nothing is issued from the immaculate hearts of these Holy Infallibles except statements proving that they have received these words from the Most High Origin. The ziyarah of ‘Ashura’, however, is similar to the Words of Almighty Allah that He revealed to Archangel Jibraeel. This fact can be noticed in the words of this form of ziyarah, including the statements of invoking curses (on the enemies), the statements of invoking blessings (on the Imam and his companions), and the supplicatory statements. Hence, Archangel Jibraeel conveyed these words to the Seal of the Prophets. As maintained by tangible experiences, this form of ziyarah is unique in achieving the requests, gaining the needs, and warding off the enemies if a visitor recites it continuously for forty days or even less. However, the most astonishing effect of preserving in reciting this form of ziyarah can be touched in the following story, mentioned in the book of Dar al-Salam. However, I will mention it in brief:
Hasan al-Yazdi the trustworthy, righteous, and pious Hajj and Mawla who lived in the vicinity of the holy shrine in al-Ghari (i.e. al-Najaf) and who was one of those who acted faithfully as regards neighboring this holy place and practiced acts of worship painstakingly, has reported the following incident from Muhammad ‘Ali al-Yazdi the trustworthy and honest Hajj:
In Yazd, there was a righteous and virtuous man who used to preoccupy himself (with acts of worship) and make preparations for his next life in his grave. He used to spend nights in a graveyard in the skirts of the city of Yazd, known as Mazar, in which a group of righteous people were buried. He had a neighbor who grew up with him since infanthood and both joined the same school and studied under the same mentor. Nevertheless, this neighbor became a tither (i.e. he seizes tenth of the people’s gains by means of power and injustice). He did not quit this process until he died. He was then buried in that graveyard in a grave near the place where the righteous man used to stay overnight.
In less than one month after the death of this tither, his righteous neighbor saw him in sleep in a good-looking costume as if he was enjoying the brightness of bliss. The righteous man approached the dead man and asked him, “I know very well your origin and your end, and your open appearance and your hidden manners. You were not one of those whom are expected to have righteous inner self and your deeds would bring you nothing but torment and chastisement. How could you attain this status?”
The dead replied, “What you have just said is exactly the truth. I had been placed in the most terrible torture since my death up to yesterday when the wife of Ashraf, the blacksmith, died and was buried in this place.” The dead pointed to a definite side, which was about one hundred arms away from his burial place. He then went on, “At the night of her burial, Abu-’Abdullah (Imam al-Husayn) visited her three times. In the third time, he ordered torture to be stopped from all the dead inhabitants of this graveyard. Since then, I was turned into bliss, luxury, comfort, and coziness.”
When the righteous man woke up, he was deeply perplexed. He therefore went to the market of the blacksmiths to ask about the man whose wife had recently died, because he had no familiarity with that man. When he found the blacksmith, he asked him, “Did you have a wife?” The blacksmith answered, “Yes, I had. She died recently and she was buried in such-and-such place.” The man mentioned the very place to which the dead tither pointed in the dream of the righteous man. “Had she ever visited the tomb of Abu-’Abdullah?” the righteous man asked. “No, she had not,” answered her widower. “Did she usually mention the misfortunes that the Imam (a.s.) had to encounter?” asked the righteous man. “No, she did not,” answered her widower. “Was she usually holding consolation ceremonies for Imam al-Husayn (a.s.)?” asked the righteous man. “No, she was not,” answered her widower, who added, “What for are you putting such questions?” Here, the righteous man narrated the whole story of his dream. The widower then said, “Yes, she used to recite ziyarah of ‘Ashura’ very frequently.”
We pray to Allah – the Almighty – that He includes us among the fortunate ones – those who have the taufeeq of reciting Ziyaarat-e-Ashoora regularly.

0.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اﷲ
0.en: Peace be on you, O Abu Abdillah.

1.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ابْنَ رَسُوْلِ اللهِ
1.en: Peace be on you, O son of the Messenger of Allah.

2.en: Peace be on you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful

3.en: and the son of the chief of the successors.

4.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَابْنَ فَاطِمَۃَ سَیِّدَۃِ نِسَآءِ الْعَالَمِیْنَ
4.en: Peace be on you, O son of Fatima, the chief of the women of the worlds.

5.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا خِیَرَۃَ اللهِ وَابْنَ خِیَرَتِهٖ
5.en: Salutation on you O the good creation of Allah and the son of His best creation!

6.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا ثَارَ اللهِ وَابْنَ ثاَرِهٖ وَالْوِتْرَ الْمَوْتُوْرَ
6.en: Peace be on you, O (you whose) blood (is avenged by) Allah and son of (him whose) blood (is avenged by) Him, O the lone one whose blood is yet unavenged.

7.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ وَعَلَی الْأَرْوَاحِ الَّتِیْ حَلَّتْ بِفِنَآئِكَ
7.en: Peace be on you, and on the souls who died with you.

8.ar: عَلَیْكُمْ مِنِّی جَمِیْعًا سَلَامُ اللهِ اَبَدًا
8.en: I send peace of AIlah on all of you forever,

9.en: so long as I remain alive, and the night and day remains.

11.en: great is the loss, and unbearable

12.en: and great is your tragedy for us,

13.en: and for all the people of Islam,

14.en: and unbearable and great is your tragedy in the heavens,

15.en: for all the dwellers of the heavens.

16.ar: فَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّۃً اَسَّسَتْ اَسَاسَ الظُّلْمِ وَالْجَوْرِ عَلَیْكُمْ اَهْلَ الْبَیْتِ
16.en: May Allah curse the people who laid the basis of oppression, and the wrongs done against you, people of the House

17.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ اُمَّۃً دَفَعَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَقَامِكُمْ
17.en: May Allah curse the people who pushed you away from your position,

18.ar: وَاَزَالَتْكُمْ عَنْ مَرَاتِبِكُمُ الَّتِیْ رَتَّبَكُمُ اللهُ فِیْهَا
18.en: and removed you from your ranks in which Allah had placed you.

19.en: May Allah curse the people who killed you,

20.en: and those who made it easy for them,

21.en: by preparing the grounds for your killing.

22.en: I disassociate myself, before Allah and before you, from them,

23.en: and their adherents, their followers, and their friends.

25.en: I am at peace with those who make peace with you,

26.ar: وَحَرْبٌ لِمَنْ حَارَبَكُمْ اِلی یَوْمِ الْقِیَامَۃِ
26.en: And I am at war with those who make war with you, till the Day of Judgement.

27.ar: وَلَعَنَ اللهُ آلَ زِیَادٍ وَآلَ مَرْوَانَ
27.en: And may Allah curse the family of Ziyaad and the family of Marwaan;

28.en: And may Allah curse the group and the tribe of Umiyyah, one and all, altogether;

29.en: And may Allah curse Ibne Marjanah

30.en: And may Allah curse Umar ibne Sa`ad,

32.en: And may Allah curse the nation that saddled up,

33.en: reined in, and veiled themselves for the fight against you.

34.ar: بِاَبِیْ اَنْتَ وَاُمِّی لَقَدْ عَظُمَ مُصَابِیْ بِكَ
34.en: My father and mother be sacrificed for you, great is my sorrow for you.

35.en: I pray to Allah who has honoured your status,

36.ar: وَاَكْرَمَنِیْ بِكَ اَنْ یَرْزُقَنِیْ طَلَبَ ثَارِكَ
36.en: and honoured me through you, to grant me (the chance) to avenge your blood

37.ar: مَعَ اِمَامٍ مَنْصُوْرٍ مِنْ اَهْلِ بَیْتِ مُحَمَّدٍ
37.en: to be with a victorious Imam, from the family of Muhammad,

38.en: blessings of Allah be on him and his family.

39.en: O Allah, make me worthy of respect with You, through Husayn,

40.en: peace be on him, in this world and the Hereafter.

43.en: and to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,

44.en: to Fatima, and to Hasan, and to you,

45.ar: بِمُوَالَاتِكَ وَبِالْبَرَآئَۃِ مِمَّنْ قَاتَلَكَ وَنَصَبَ لَك الْحَرْبَ
45.en: through love for you, and disassociating with those who killed you, and prepared to fight you

46.ar: وَبِالْبَرَآئَۃِ مِمَّنْ اَسَّسَ اَسَاسَ الظُّلْمِ وَالْجَوْرِ عَلَیْكُمْ
46.en: and those who established the foundations of tyranny, and wrongs against you (O Ahl al-Bayt).

47.en: I turn to Allah and His Messenger, disassociating myself

48.ar: مِمَّنْ اَسَّسَ اَسَاسَ ذٰلِكَ وَبَنی عَلَیْهِ بُنْیَانَهٗ
48.en: from those who laid the grounds for it, and those who built upon it,

49.ar: وَجَرٰی فِیْ ظُلْمِهٖ وَجَوْرِهٖ عَلَیْكُمْ وَعَلی اَشْیَاعِكُمْ
49.en: and carried out oppression and cruelty on you and on your followers.

50.en: I disassociate myself from them before Allah and before you,

51.en: and seek nearness to Allah, and then to you

52.en: through love for you and your friends,

54.en: and from those who went to war with you,

56.en: I am at peace with those who made peace with you,

57.en: and I am at war with those who went to war with you.

58.en: I befriend those who befriended you,

59.en: and I am at enmity with those who were your enemies.

60.en: I pray to Allah, who has honored me with awareness of you,

62.en: and has enabled me to withdraw from your enemies.

63.ar: اَنْ یَجْعَلَنِیْ مَعَكُمْ فِیْ الدُّنْیَا وَاْلآخِرَۃِ
63.en: (I pray) that He may place me with you in this world and the Hereafter.

64.ar: وَاَنْ یُثَبِّتَ لِی عِنْدَ كُمْ قَدَمَ صِدْقٍ
64.en: And (I pray) that He may strengthen for me a truthful stance

65.en: in this world and the Hereafter.

66.ar: وَاَسْئَلُهُ اَنْ یُبَلِّغَنِی الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُوْدَ لَكُمْ عِنْدَ اللهِ
66.en: And I pray that He may enable me to reach, your honoured station with Allah

67.en: and that He may grant me (the chance) to avenge (your) blood

68.ar: مَعَ اِمَامٍ هُدًی ظَاهِرٍ نَاطِقٍ بِالْحَقِّ مِنْكُمْ
68.en: along with a rightly guided Imam from amongst you, who will surely come and speak the truth.

69.ar: وَاَسْئَلُ اللهَ بِحَقِّكُمْ وَبِالشَّانِ الَّذِیْ لَكُمْ عِنْدَهٗ
69.en: I ask Allah for your sake, and by the honoured position you have with Him,

70.en: that He grants me, for my grief over you,

71.en: the best that He grants anyone grieving over a tragedy.

73.en: How great was your tragedy for Islam,

74.en: and all the Heavens and the earth!

75.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِیْ فِیْ مَقَامِیْ هٰذَا مِمَّنْ
75.en: O Allah, make me, at this moment,

76.en: one who receives from You, blessings, mercy, and forgiveness.

77.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ مَحْیَایَ مَحْیَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
77.en: O Allah make me live the life of Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and his family

78.en: and make me die the death of Muhammad (s.a.w.a.) and his family.

79.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنَّ هٰذَا یَوْمٌ تَبَرَّكَتْ بِهٖ بَنُوْ اُمَیَّۃَ
79.en: O Allah, this is a day which the Bani Umayyah took as a blessed day,

80.en: and the son of the liver-eater,

81.en: the accursed son of the accursed, as declared by You

82.ar: وَلِسَانِ نَبِیِّكَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِهٖ
82.en: and the tongue of Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be on him and his family,

83.en: in every place and at every occasion

84.ar: وَقَفَ فِیْهِ نَبِیُّكَ صَلَّی اللهُ عَلَیْهِ وَآلِهٖ
84.en: where Your Prophet, blessings of Allah be on him and his family, stood.

85.en: O Allah, curse Abu Sufyan, Mu`awiya,

87.en: let it be an everlasting curse upon them from Thee.

88.ar: وَهٰذَا یَوْمٌ فَرِحَتْ بِهٖ آلُ زِیادٍ وَآلُ مَرْوَانَ
88.en: And this is a day when the family of Ziyad was happy, and the family of Marwan,

89.en: because of their murder of Husayn, blessings of Allah be on him.

90.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ فَضَاعِفْ عَلَیْهِمُ الَّعْنَ مِنْكَ وَالْعَذَابَ الْاَلِيْمَ
90.en: O Allah, so increase the curse on them from You, and the painful punishment.

91.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّیْ اَتَقَرَّبُ اِلَیْكَ فِیْ هٰذَا الْیَوْمِ
91.en: O Allah, I seek nearness to You on this day,

92.en: and in this position, and for the rest of my life,

93.en: through disassociating with them (the enemies) and cursing them,

94.en: and through the love of Your Prophet and the family of Your Prophet,

95.en: peace be on him and on them.

97.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنْ اَوّلَ ظَالِمٍ ظَلَمَ حَقَّ مُحَمَّدٍ
97.en: O Allah, curse the first tyrant who oppressed, the right of Muhammad

98.ar: وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآخِرَ تَابِعٍ لَهٗ عَلٰی ذٰلِكَ
98.en: and his family, and the next who followed him on that.

99.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ الْعَنِ الْعِصَابَۃَ الَّتِیْ جَاهَدَتِ الْحُسَیْنَ
99.en: O Allah, curse the group who fought Husayn,

100.en: and the group which followed and supported, and joined hands to kill him.

103.ar: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَیْكَ یَا اَبَا عَبْدِ اللهِ
103.en: Peace be on You O Abu Abdillah

104.en: and on the souls that died with you.

105.en: Greetings of Peace of Allah be on you, from me, forever,

106.en: so long as I live, and so long as the night and day remain.

107.ar: وَلَا جَعَلَهُ اللهُ آخِرَ الْعَهْدِ مِنِّی لِزِیَارَتِكُمْ
107.en: May Allah not make it my last contact of ziyarat with you.

109.en: and on Ali the son of Husayn,

110.en: And on the children of Husayn

113.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ خُصَّ اَنْتَ اَوَّلَ ظَالِمٍ بِاللَّعْنِ مِنِّی
113.en: O Allah, single out the first oppressor with my curse,

115.en: then the second, the third, and the fourth.

116.en: O Allah, curse the fifth one, Yazid,

117.ar: وَالْعَنْ عُبَیْدَ اللهِ بْنِ زِیَادٍ وَابْنَ مَرْجَانَۃَ
117.en: and Ubaidallah bin Ziyad, Ibne Marjanah,

118.en: and Umar ibne Sa’d, and Shimr,

119.en: and the family of Abu Sufyan, the family of Ziyad,

120.en: and the family of Marwan, till the Day of Judgement

121.en: Then go in Sajdah and say:

122.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ حَمْدَ الشَّاكِرِیْنَ لَكَ عَلٰی مُصَابِهِمْ
122.en: O Allah, for You is Praise, Praise of those who are thankful to You (even) during tragedy.

123.en: Praise be to Allah for my intense grief

124.ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ ارْزُقْنِیْ شَفَاعَۃَ الْحُسَیْنِ یَوْمَ الْوُرُوْدِ
124.en: O Allah, grant me the intercession of Husayn, on the Day of appearance (before You),

125.en: and strengthen for me a truthful stand with You,

126.en: with Husayn and the companions of Husayn,

127.ar: بَذَلُوْا مُهَجَهُمْ دُوْنَ الْحُسَیْنِ عَلَیْهِ السَّلَامُ.
127.en: who sacrificed everything, for Husayn, peace be on him.
